evidence: Two Ru precursors, RuCp 2 and Ru(EtCp) 2, were vaporized in separate bubblers heated at 85 /C176 Ca n d6 5 /C176 C, respectively. And vapors of Ru precursor with argon (Ar) carrier at a flow rate of 20 sccm and NH 3 gas of 200 sccm with plasma power of 300 W were introduced to the reaction chamber alternately. Another Ar gas exposure step for purging was employed to removing the byproducts and excess gas molecules.
